title: Mighty Diamonds (Horsemouth - Vin Gordon) - I Need A Roof

lines.l: Everybody loves it, even mine loves it
I need a roof, oh, this is where I'm not headed
I need some roof, oh, this is where I'm not headed
And pray on my day
And pray on my day
With a glow in my heart
With a glow for everyone
Remember when y'all been slain
Sometimes I'm out late, don't say
Everybody on the radio
Even mine
Remember the galaxy, remember when it rose since man said
Time ago dread, every gully ago run dread
I need a room over my head
I need a room now over my head
And pray I need some faith on my bed
And pray, yeah, yeah, yeah
Let it flow, flow in my heart
Let it flow, let it flow for everyone
And still I see
It's the child
Power of the Trinity
Build your mind in discouragement
